evidence.note: Built an independent PyTorch reference oracle first and verified the kernel 'matches the reference exactly' before optimizing — establishes ground-truth, above the 0/3 anchors.

Engaged rigorously with the tolerance semantics (atol+rtol*|b|), separating max_abs vs max_rel and reasoning about which magnitudes pass — 'is the math right' vs 'is tolerance met' thinking (level-10 flavor).
Deliberately expanded coverage to more shapes 'to be safer' including bigger shapes with Cauchy and N=768/D=384; a representative spread across shapes and distributions (level 5+).

Stressed the hardest numerical corner: Cauchy inputs at the 2e-2 boundary (max_abs~0.025) and re-ran 5x to catch intermittent extreme-value failures — deliberate probing of accumulation/heavy-tail error.
Treated any correctness mismatch as blocking: repeatedly reverted bf16 changes and localized which stage (projections, final to_out, og gate) breached tolerance — mismatch localization per level 8.

reasoning: The agent clearly exceeds anchor 5 — it built a trustworthy PyTorch reference, checked a representative spread of shapes with Cauchy cases at the stated tolerance, treated failures as blocking, and localized numeric breakages. It also shows level-8/10 traits: separating 'math right' from 'tolerance met' and deliberately stressing the hardest Cauchy-at-boundary corner with repeated runs. It falls short of a clean 8 because there is no evidence of a fully systematic parametrized sweep across the whole batch×N×dim grid and both mask states, nor an independent reference-vs-einsum check; coverage grew ad hoc rather than exhaustively. That places it at 7.
